# Sourced by the candidate shell, which runs as mapped root in a fresh user and
# mount namespace. optpkg_enter puts writable overlays over /usr/lib and
# /var/lib. optpkg_use NAME [ROOT] installs the staged NAME package with pkg,
# verifies it and loads it. A static executable cannot load shared objects:
# there pkg load must refuse, and optpkg_static is yes.
optpkg_dir=/opt/bashos-parity/reference-data/optional-packages
optpkg_static=no
optpkg_enter() {
  local ov=$HOME/optpkg-overlay
  if /usr/bin/ldd "$BASH" 2>&1 | /usr/bin/grep -q 'not a dynamic executable'; then optpkg_static=yes; fi
  /usr/bin/mkdir -p "$ov/u-lib" "$ov/w-lib" "$ov/u-var" "$ov/w-var" &&
  /usr/bin/mount -t overlay overlay -o "lowerdir=/usr/lib,upperdir=$ov/u-lib,workdir=$ov/w-lib" /usr/lib &&
  /usr/bin/mount -t overlay overlay -o "lowerdir=/var/lib,upperdir=$ov/u-var,workdir=$ov/w-var" /var/lib ||
    { echo 'optpkg: cannot prepare a writable package root' >&2; return 98; }
}
optpkg_use() {
  local name=$1 root=() log=$HOME/optpkg-$1 rc
  local file=("$optpkg_dir/packages/${name}"_*.pkg)
  [[ $# -lt 2 ]] || root=(--root "$2")
  pkg install -A "${file[0]}" "${root[@]}" > "$log.install" 2>&1 &&
  pkg verify "$name" "${root[@]}" > "$log.verify" 2>&1 ||
    { echo "optpkg: $name: pkg install or pkg verify failed"; return 1; }
  pkg load "$name" "${root[@]}" > "$log.load" 2>&1; rc=$?
  if [[ $optpkg_static == yes ]]; then
    [[ $rc != 0 ]] && /usr/bin/grep -q 'this executable is static and cannot load shared objects' "$log.load" ||
      { echo "optpkg: $name: a static executable did not refuse pkg load (status $rc)"; return 1; }
  else
    [[ $rc == 0 && $(type -t "$name") == builtin ]] ||
      { echo "optpkg: $name: pkg load failed (status $rc)"; return 1; }
  fi
}
